facts.value: The degree in Interaction Design provides you with the skills and knowledge to think creatively about how we interact with the technologies that surround us and to develop designs that are people-centred in innovative ways.
Interaction and User Experience Design is constantly evolving.
Design engaging interactive experiences for users building on new technologies.
Understand what people want and how to design suitable interfaces and interactions working with technologies.
Critical and creative thinking to continuously evolve with the needs of users and developments in emerging technologies.
Identify and respond to people’s needs using a number of people-centred design methods.
Access to cutting-edge hardware, software and the support of expert lecturers and technicians.
Prototyping apps on mobile platforms (e.g. Android).
Producing screen-based content with creative software (e.g. Affinity Suite, Processing, Figma, Fusion 360, DaVinci Resolve).
Building interactive objects with physical computing (e.g. Arduino, Raspberry Pi).
Exploring interactive programming (e.g. Processing, HTML, CSS, Javascript).
